newsitem.title: UK: UBS to trade DAPS in Hanson demerger firms.
newsitem.headline: UBS to trade DAPS in Hanson demerger firms.

text.p: UBS confirmed that it is issuing on Wednesday derivative products in Hanson's four demerged companies.
The so-called Demerger Advance Participation Securities (DAPS) will allow investors to invest in those parts of the demerged Hanson in advance of the October 1 demerger.
DAPS in Imperial Tobacco Group, Millennium Chemicals, the Energy Group and the remaining Hanson Plc company are expected to begin trading this morning.
The DAPS are immediately exchangeable into the shares of the new companies once the full demerger is effected, UBS said.
The shares in Millenium Chemicals and Imperial Tobacco are expected to start trading in New York and London, respectively, in early October.
However, Hanson has said the listing of the Energy Group is unlikely to go ahead before the first quarter of 1997.
Following the demerger, the remaining Hanson businesses, consisting largely of building materials companies in the UK and the U.S., will continue to trade as Hanson Plc.
